messages:
Rahil P: We had another partial config apply yesterday; one router updated, the other timed out. Need a safer apply flow.
Maya Z: Can we add a transactions resource? POST /configs/transactions -> tx-id. Coordinator persists intent + snapshots, fans out, and reconciles.
Oren H: Rollback needs snapshots + idempotent service apply endpoints. If a service can't support rollback mark it non-transactional and warn the user.
Console-Steve: UX: preflight + risk score, list transaction-capable targets, pause window for canaries, and force-commit with justification.
telemetry-bot: Proposed events: tx.created, tx.target.{apply,rollback}, tx.final. Fields: tx_id, initiator, targets, policy, start_ts, end_ts, result.
Maya Z: API options: single /apply with strategy param vs explicit /transactions resource. I vote transactions for clarity and easier polling.
Rahil P: Action items: Maya draft RFC for transactions + coordinator (due Tue). Oren to list non-transactional services. Steve to mock preflight UI. Telemetry bot to open schema PR.
Console-Steve: Will include If-Match examples and a default "Apply + Verify" button.
Maya Z: Also recommend quorum policy (N of M) and pause_on_failure thresholds.
Rahil P: Good. I'll schedule a 30m sync to align on snapshot format. Add comments on the RFC when it's up. :thumbsup:
